observations.trace: The UI NATURAL array contains eight text names and show passes each to HairPigment.named, which forwards the name to HairMaterial.named to match the same eight cases and create pigment shares. The resulting typed pigment is retained; names are also projected for tooltips. Dye.name is final presentation, and arbitrary dye/sliders are separate modes.
observations.remaining: Historical delegate personally established this producer→bridge→palette→UI trace and named original q403. The current full bodies match the historical revision. Exact owner, external text API boundary, all producers/consumers and aliases remain open; no UI was executed.

observations.trace: Clump and Curl obtain a GuideMap and dereference selected indices. GuideMap.new first searches nearby compatible groups but, when none is found, performs an unrestricted nearest search; the selected guide then supplies clump/curl geometry.
observations.remaining: Historical Adler q164 already identified this conditional CPU policy. Mask, geometry, missing-group behavior, PointGrid and malformed aggregate admission remain separate; previous GPU fallback is related but not automatically identical. No clump, curl, grid or product probe ran.

observations.trace: Clump default reuse_guide_map is false; generated Look coarse and fine clumps use that default, while generated Curl explicitly sets false. Standalone Curl defaults true and GuideMap.get reuses a stored map when requested.
observations.remaining: Earlier Adler367 and delegate756 recorded the intended branches; this closes only the simple stale-map-reuse suspicion for these generated Look clump/curl calls. Other public operations and cached map admission remain open.

observations.trace: Look divides turns per metre by3 at the native Curl handoff, and Curl multiplies frequency by3. HairMaterial documents coat as offline metadata and quarter-absorption as intentional real-time calibration.
observations.remaining: Operation order, float rounding, native GPU equivalence, physical bounds and all material consumers remain open. No renderer or numerical product code was executed.

observations.trace: Creator HairPigment TryFrom checks inclusive shares, while public new/dyed clamp their arguments before retaining them; material stores public raw floating fields.
observations.remaining: The existing current pigment admission ledger row already tracks programmatic NaN, historical attribution and unresolved visual effects. Do not count this support as a second finding or claim ordinary UI creates NaN.
